description: Document the new White Edition Start-menu extension and wire it into the existing White Edition documentation and dconf defaults. Depends on FEAT-001 (the extension must exist). Additive and reversible.
steps: Write gnome-source/conf/white-edition/shell-extension/white-edition@mearvk/README.md in the White Edition doc voice (precise, declarative, no marketing, no em dashes). Cover: extension structure/files; the 'button stays bottom-left, only the popup moves' contract stated explicitly; the start-menu-alignment key and its left/center/right semantics with left as default; the 3 logo candidates (names, visual description) and how to select via the start-button-logo key / prefs UI / gsettings command; install steps via install.sh (target root, schema compile); the chosen shell-version; honest note of any restart/relogin requirement and which behaviors could not be verified without a live GNOME Shell; and a trademark note that the Ubuntu Circle of Friends is a Canonical trademark and these marks are deliberately original 'Ubuntu-themed' art, consistent with ubuntu-white/README.md's disclaimer.

Update gnome-source/conf/white-edition/README.md: in the section that states bottom placement 'should be implemented through the supported Shell extension/customization layer', add a reference to the new shell-extension/white-edition@mearvk/ as that implementation, and add the extension to the Layout tree block. Keep additive; do not remove existing content.

Update gnome-source/conf/white-edition/db/local.d/00-white-edition: add a commented DEFAULT (not a lock) documenting the default Start-menu alignment, e.g. a [org/gnome/shell/extensions/white-edition] section with start-menu-alignment='left' and a comment noting it is a default users may override, consistent with the file's existing 'defaults, not locks' header. Note the extension must be enabled/installed for the key to take effect.

Run xmllint/markdown sanity as applicable and grep to confirm the README cross-references resolve (the extension path referenced in the White Edition README exists). Commit on branch feat/white-edition-start-menu with a docs: commit message.
acceptance_criteria: shell-extension/white-edition@mearvk/README.md exists and documents the alignment key, the 3 logos + selection method, install steps, the button-stays-left contract, restart caveats, and the trademark note.
gnome-source/conf/white-edition/README.md references the new extension as the shell-layer implementation and lists it in the layout tree.
db/local.d/00-white-edition contains a DEFAULT (commented, not a lock) for the start-menu alignment consistent with the file's existing style.
No em dashes in any added prose. No vendored upstream GNOME source modified.
verification: grep -rn '\xe2\x80\x94' gnome-source/conf/white-edition/shell-extension/ gnome-source/conf/white-edition/README.md (expect no matches; em dash check)
findings: Completed and committed on feat/white-edition-start-menu as 40f05e4e09 (docs:). The extension README from FEAT-001 already covered structure, the button-stays-left contract, the alignment key with left default, the 3 logo candidates, install steps, and the shell-version (46 target, [46,47] in metadata). It was MISSING three required items, which were added additively: (1) a 'Selecting the alignment and logo' section with gsettings set/get command examples plus a GSETTINGS_SCHEMA_DIR note; (2) 'Restart and relogin caveats' (Xorg restart vs Wayland relogin, schema-compile ordering, live changed:: signal behavior) and a 'Verification status' section listing what could not be verified without a live GNOME Shell versus what was validated statically; (3) a 'Trademark note' stating the Ubuntu Circle of Friends is a Canonical Ltd trademark and the bundled logos are deliberately original Ubuntu-themed art, consistent with ubuntu-white/README.md. gnome-source/conf/white-edition/README.md: added a paragraph referencing shell-extension/white-edition@mearvk/ as the Shell-layer panel implementation right after the existing 'supported Shell extension/customization layer' passage, and added the extension subtree to the Layout code block (additive, nothing removed). db/local.d/00-white-edition: added a commented [org/gnome/shell/extensions/white-edition] section with start-menu-alignment='left', documented as a default not a lock and noting the extension must be installed/enabled for the key to take effect, matching the file's existing defaults-not-locks style. Verification: test -f extension README OK; grep 'shell-extension' in config README matches (lines 29, 93); grep 'start-menu-alignment' in dconf file matches (line 17); em-dash (U+2014) scan of all three edited files returned zero matches. No vendored upstream GNOME source was touched. No code files changed, so no build/JS-check step was needed for this docs-only feature; FEAT-001's static validation still holds.
